## Editor interface

```typescript
export interface Editor
```

<tbody><tr><td>

[apply()](./sh-codemod.editor.apply.md)


</td><td>

Applies every queued edit to the original text and returns the result. Text outside the edited ranges is returned exactly. It does not consume the queue, so more edits may be queued and `apply()` called again; the original text is never modified.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[insertBefore(node, text)](./sh-codemod.editor.insertbefore.md)


</td><td>

Queues inserting `text` immediately before the node's first character, leaving the node itself untouched.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[replaceNode(node, newText)](./sh-codemod.editor.replacenode.md)


</td><td>

Queues replacing the node's source text with `newText`<!-- -->. The node's extent is the parser's own, so, for example, a `Stmt` does not include its leading comments or its `;`<!-- -->.


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>
